snippet.title: The Posthumous Investigation - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Posthumous Investigation is available now on Steam. Watch the launch trailer for The Posthumous Investigation, a time-loop murder mystery game from developer Mother Gaia Studio. 

In The Posthumous Investigation, play as a private investigator who’s been hired by a rather unusual client: an influential entrepreneur who’s already dead. The task? You only have a single day to solve the mystery of his murder. Adventure through a hand-drawn, noir-drenched 1937 Rio de Janeiro and learn about the lives of a cast of unique characters. Question their actions, challenge their motives, and manipulate their routines to uncover as much information as you can. When the day resets, take your knowledge with you through the time loop to stay one step ahead of the killer. In The Posthumous Investigation, death is the client, and time is your only weapon.
